sources.title: Humanizer: 12B Model for Local AI Text Rewriting
sources.snippet: Humanizer is a specialized 12-billion parameter language model designed to rewrite AI-generated drafts into text that reads as if written by a human. It supports English and Chinese, covering formats such as emails, essays, reports, and forum posts.

sources.title: Humanizer Ai - a Hugging Face Space by conversantech

sources.title: guygrigsby/humanizer-12b-mlx-6bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 12B model that rewrites AI-written drafts (emails, essays, reports, forum posts; English and Chinese) so they read like a person wrote them. It is trained to keep every number, unit, date, name and quote and to add nothing, and it runs locally.
